name: https link
reason: absolute https address: masked

name: http link in a sentence
reason: absolute http address: masked; the target is the canonical URL

name: mailto link
reason: mailto address: masked

name: two links
reason: each link is masked on its own

name: javascript address
reason: not http, https or mailto: as typed

name: ftp address
reason: not http, https or mailto: as typed

name: irc address
reason: irc is not masked: as typed

name: relative address
reason: not absolute: as typed

name: address without a scheme
reason: not absolute: as typed

name: scheme without a host
reason: no host: as typed

name: space in the address
reason: an address has no spaces: as typed

name: empty text
reason: nothing to show: as typed

name: blank text
reason: nothing to show: as typed

name: unclosed address
reason: no closing parenthesis: as typed

name: text across lines
reason: a link stays on one line: as typed

name: in a code span
reason: inside code (IRC monospace): as typed

name: in a fenced block
reason: inside a fenced block: as typed in the block (visible is the code)

name: non-canonical address
reason: parses as an absolute https URL; target and tooltip are the canonical form

name: bidi control in the address
reason: the canonical URL percent-encodes the control, so the tooltip cannot be reordered

name: domain naming another host
reason: text names another host: not masked

name: url naming another host
reason: text names another host: not masked

name: domain with a path naming another host
reason: text names another host: not masked

name: user info in the address
reason: an address with user info is never masked

name: user info behind plain words
reason: an address with user info is never masked: it reads as paypal.com

name: email naming another domain
reason: text names another host: not masked

name: bold domain naming another host
reason: formatting does not hide the domain: not masked

name: a domain among other words
reason: any word naming another host blocks masking

name: www is another host
reason: hosts compare exactly: www.example.com is not example.com

name: look-alike letters
reason: the Cyrillic host normalises to another host: not masked

name: ideographic full stop
reason: U+3002 is a dot in host names: names paypal.com

name: fullwidth full stop
reason: U+FF0E is a dot in host names: names paypal.com

name: zero-width space
reason: invisible characters are ignored: names paypal.com

name: right-to-left override
reason: invisible controls are ignored: still a domain

name: trailing ellipsis
reason: punctuation around a word is trimmed: names paypal.com

name: guillemets
reason: punctuation around a word is trimmed: names paypal.com

name: curly apostrophe
reason: words split at punctuation: names paypal.com

name: em dash
reason: words split at punctuation: names paypal.com

name: ip address
reason: an IPv4 address names a host: not masked

name: domain naming the same host
reason: text names the link's own host: masked

name: case and trailing dot
reason: hosts compare lowercased with one trailing dot stripped: masked

name: url naming the same host
reason: text names the link's own host: masked

name: email naming the same domain
reason: text names the link's own host: masked

name: version number
reason: a number is not a domain: masked

name: word with a colon
reason: a word ending in a colon is not an address: masked

name: formatting kept
reason: bold and italic inside the text are kept

name: nested brackets
reason: balanced brackets belong to the text

name: escaped closing bracket
reason: \] is a bracket in the text; the backslash is not shown

name: escaped opening bracket in the text
reason: \[ is a bracket in the text; the backslash is not shown

name: escaped opening bracket
reason: an escaped [ opens no link: as typed

name: parentheses in the address
reason: balanced parentheses belong to the address

name: link in parentheses
reason: the outer parentheses stay text

name: sentence full stop
reason: the full stop after the link stays text

name: space before the address
reason: a space between ] and ( makes no link: as typed

name: brackets alone
reason: no address: as typed

name: link inside an unclosed bracket
reason: the unclosed [ is text; the inner link is masked

name: inner link wins over an unmasked outer one
reason: the outer text holds an address, so the outer is not masked; the inner link is
